order_warnings: rule year_full: branches 1 and 2 are order-dependent (shared first bytes; ordered choice is decisive)
rule year_full: branches 1 and 3 are order-dependent (shared first bytes; ordered choice is decisive)
rule year_full: branches 2 and 3 are order-dependent (shared first bytes; ordered choice is decisive)
rule yr_sep: branches 1 and 3 are order-dependent (shared first bytes; ordered choice is decisive)

source:
# Port of lib/pubid/ieee/ire/parser.rb — IRE (pre-IEEE) designations:
# year-first and prefix-first forms, types (Trans./Standard/Std),
# numbers (dotted letters, IRE-glued, letters-dash) and dates.
# Consumed by the ieee grammar via `use ire`.
#
# Edition-2 notes: the year / year_full bodies are inlined at every
# capture site (a capture wrapping a rule ref expands to element hashes,
# while the inlined body binds as one scalar string), and the helper
# spaces around captures stay raw literals (a parenthesized ref
# materializes a stray named node).

grammar PubidIre version "0.1.0" edition 2 {
  digit = %x30-39
  upper = %x41-5A
  space = " "
  dash = "-"
  dot = "."

  year_short = (%x31-36 %x30-39)
  year_full = (("191" %x30-39)) / (("19" ("2" / "3" / "4" / "5") %x30-39)) / (("196" %x30-33))
  ire_prefix = ("IEEE-IRE" / "IRE") as publisher
  ire_type = ("Trans." / "Standard" / "Std") as type
  number = {
    (
      ( 1*(%x30-39) (" " / ".") %x41-5A 1*(%x30-39) )
      / ( 1*(%x30-39) "." "IRE" 1*(%x30-39) "." 1*(%x30-39) %x41-5A 1*(%x30-39) )
      / ( 2*4%x41-5A "-" 1*(%x30-39) )
      / ( 1*(%x30-39) )
    ) as number
  }
  yr_sep = (space [(dash / ",")] [space]) / (dash / ",") / space

  # The trailing optional stays flattened on purpose: a nested
  # [([x] [y])] compiles to branches that commit past the leading space
  # in the pure-Ruby VM, losing the backtrack the year-less forms need.
  ire_identifier_year_first = {
    (
      ("191" %x30-39)
      / ("19" ("2" / "3" / "4" / "5") %x30-39)
      / ("196" %x30-33)
      / (%x31-36 %x30-39)
    ) as year
    " " ire_prefix " " [ire_type " "] number
    [ yr_sep (
      ("191" %x30-39)
      / ("19" ("2" / "3" / "4" / "5") %x30-39)
      / ("196" %x30-33)
    ) as full_year ]
  }
  ire_identifier_prefix_first = {
    ire_prefix " " [ire_type " "] number
    [ yr_sep (
      ("191" %x30-39)
      / ("19" ("2" / "3" / "4" / "5") %x30-39)
      / ("196" %x30-33)
      / (%x31-36 %x30-39)
    ) as year ]
  }
  ire_identifier = ire_identifier_year_first / ire_identifier_prefix_first

  entry ire_identifier: ire_identifier

  bindings ire_identifier {
    publisher -> publisher (string)
    type -> type (string)
    number -> number (string)
    year -> year (string)
    full_year -> full_year (string)
  }

  test {
    accept "IRE Trans. PGI-7"
    accept "1930 IRE 20"
    accept "IRE Standard 15 S1"
    accept "IRE 28"
    reject "nonsense"
  }
}
